defects.quote: Autoscaling will cut the cost of the ingest tier by 45%.
CPU is the metric that every other team uses for autoscaling, so it is the right signal for the ingest workers.
defects.known_rebuttal: What other teams use says nothing about this workload. The ingest workers are queue consumers, and the stated goal is about how long a file waits, which CPU does not measure: workers blocked on warehouse writes or on large downloads show low CPU while the backlog grows, and an idle fleet with an empty queue and a fleet starved of work look the same. The autoscaler supports external and object metrics, so the design can scale directly on queue depth or on the age of the oldest file, which is the quantity the goal is written in.
